text:
The evidence confirms the 2015 loss but does not say why it happened.

Hansen Global Forest Change records a supported stand-replacing loss event of 25.5 ha in 2015 on this 2,843.1 ha property. It is one of four pre-2021 events (0.8 ha in 2008, 4.8 ha in 2017, 67.7 ha in 2020). The data only show where and when canopy disappeared, not whether it was harvesting, clearing, fire, storm or something else.

One point to check: the recorded losses total about 99 ha, far more than the 23 ha of tree cover in 2000. This could reflect regrowth or replanted stands being cleared again, but the evidence doesn't say.

To find the cause, you would need other sources, such as high-resolution imagery, management records or fire data. This evidence also makes no compliance finding.
